title.zh: 卷十一 本紀第十一: 世祖八
title.raw: 卷十一 本紀第十一: 世祖八 Volume 11 Annals 11: Shizu 8

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月癸卯朔，高麗國王王春遣其僉議中贊金方慶來賀，兼奉歲貢。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on the guimao new moon, King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched his Privy Council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and also present the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the guimao new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent his privy council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and present the annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命萬戶綦公直戍別失八里，賜鈔一萬二千五百錠。

translations.literal: On bingwu day wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to garrison Bie Shibali and granted twelve thousand five hundred ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to garrison Bie Shibali and granted 12,500 ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，磁州、永平縣水，給鈔貸之。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Cizhou and Yongping County suffered flooding; paper currency was issued as relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day flooding struck Cizhou and Yongping County; paper currency was issued as relief loans.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，立遷轉官員法：凡無過者授見闕，物故及過犯者選人補之，滿代者令還家以俟。

translations.literal: On bingchen day regulations for rotating officials were established: those without fault were appointed to open posts; where an incumbent had died or committed an offense, a selected person filled the post; those completing a term were ordered home to await reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day regulations for rotating officials were established: the blameless received open appointments; deaths and offenses were filled by selected replacements; those completing a term went home to await reassignment.

sentences.zh: 又定諸路差稅課程，增益者即上報，隱漏者罪之，不須履畝增稅，以搖百姓。

translations.literal: Tax levies and revenue quotas for all routes were also fixed: increases were to be reported immediately; concealment was punishable; there was to be no field-by-field tax increase to disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: Tax levies and revenue quotas for all routes were also fixed: increases had to be reported at once, concealment was punishable, and field-by-field tax hikes to disturb the people were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 詔括江淮銅及銅錢銅器。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the registration of Jianghuai copper, copper cash, and copper vessels.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the registration of Jianghuai copper, copper cash, and copper vessels.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以海賊賀文達所掠良婦百三十餘人還其家。

translations.literal: On xinyou day more than one hundred thirty respectable women seized by the sea bandit He Wenda were returned to their families.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day more than 130 respectable women seized by the sea bandit He Wenda were returned to their families.

sentences.zh: 廣西廉州海賊霍公明、鄭仲龍等伏誅。

translations.literal: The Lianzhou sea bandits of Guangxi, Huo Gongming, Zheng Zhonglong, and others, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The Lianzhou sea bandits of Guangxi, Huo Gongming, Zheng Zhonglong, and others, were executed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敕泉州行省所轄州郡山寨未即歸附者率兵拔之，已拔復叛者屠之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day an order directed that among the prefectures, districts, mountains, and stockades under the Quanzhou branch secretariat, any not yet submitted were to be taken by force; any taken and then rebelled again were to be put to the sword.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an order directed that among the prefectures, districts, mountains, and stockades under the Quanzhou branch secretariat, any not yet submitted were to be taken by force and any that rebelled after submission were to be put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 以總管張瑄、千戶羅璧收宋二王有功，升瑄沿海招討使，虎符；

translations.literal: Because commander-in-chief Zhang Xuan and qianhu Luo Bi had merit in taking the two Song princes, Xuan was promoted to coastal pacification commissioner with a tiger tally;
translations.idiomatic: Because commander-in-chief Zhang Xuan and qianhu Luo Bi had merit in taking the two Song princes, Xuan was promoted to coastal pacification commissioner with a tiger tally;

sentences.zh: 璧管軍總管，金符。

translations.literal: Bi was made army commander-in-chief with a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: Bi was made army commander-in-chief with a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔毋以侍衛軍供工匠役。

translations.literal: An edict forbade employing palace guard troops as craftsman corvée.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade employing palace guard troops as craftsman corvée.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，敕相威檢核阿裏海牙、忽都帖木兒等所俘丁三萬二千餘人，並放為民。

translations.literal: On wuchen day an order directed Xiangwei to examine the more than thirty-two thousand male captives taken by Ala Haiya, Qutuq Temür, and others, and release them all as civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an order directed Xiangwei to examine the more than 32,000 male captives taken by Ala Haiya, Qutuq Temür, and others and release them all as civilians.

sentences.zh: 置行中書省於福州。

translations.literal: A branch secretariat was established at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A branch secretariat was established at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 改德慶路為總管府。

translations.literal: Deqing Route was changed to a commander-in-chief's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Deqing Route was changed to a commander-in-chief's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 賜開灤河五衛軍鈔。

translations.literal: Paper currency was granted to the five guard armies of the Kai-Luan River region.
translations.idiomatic: Paper currency was granted to the five guard armies of the Kai-Luan River region.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，張易言：「高和尚有秘術，能役鬼為兵，遙制敵人。

translations.literal: Second month, on yihai day, Zhang Yi said: "Gao Heshang has secret arts and can command ghosts as soldiers to control enemies from afar.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yihai day, Zhang Yi said, "Gao Heshang has secret arts and can command ghosts as soldiers to control enemies from afar.

sentences.zh: 」命和禮霍孫將兵與高和尚同赴北邊。

translations.literal: " Huluhuosun was ordered to lead troops together with Gao Heshang to the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: " Huluhuosun was ordered to lead troops with Gao Heshang to the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立北京道二驛。

translations.literal: On bingzi day two relay stations were established on the Beijing circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day two relay stations were established on the Beijing circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，答裏不罕以雲南行省軍攻定昌路，擒總管谷納，殺之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Dalaibuhun led Yunnan branch secretariat troops to attack Dingchang Route, captured route commander-in-chief Gu Na, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Dalaibuhun led Yunnan branch secretariat troops against Dingchang Route, captured route commander-in-chief Gu Na, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 詔令答裏不罕還，以阿答代之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Dalaibuhun to return and replaced him with Ata.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dalaibuhun to return and replaced him with Ata.

sentences.zh: 敕非遠方歸附人毋入會同館。

translations.literal: An order forbade persons from recently submitted places who were not from distant regions to enter the Hall of Reunion.
translations.idiomatic: An order forbade persons from recently submitted places who were not from distant regions to enter the Hall of Reunion.

sentences.zh: 詔納速剌丁將精兵萬人征緬國。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Nasir al-Din to lead ten thousand picked troops against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Nasir al-Din to lead 10,000 picked troops against Burma.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賞納速剌丁所部征金齒功銀五千三百二十兩。

translations.literal: On yiyou day five thousand three hundred twenty taels of silver were granted to reward Nasir al-Din's command for merit in the campaign against Jinch'i.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day 5,320 taels of silver were granted to reward Nasir al-Din's command for merit in the campaign against Jinch'i.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命梅國賓襲其父應春瀘州安撫使職。

translations.literal: On jichou day Mei Guobin was ordered to inherit his father Yingchun's post as Luzhou pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Mei Guobin was ordered to inherit his father Yingchun's post as Luzhou pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 瀘州嘗叛，應春為前重慶制置使張玨所殺。

translations.literal: Luzhou had once rebelled; Yingchun was killed by the former Chongqing military commissioner Zhang Jue.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou had once rebelled; Yingchun was killed by the former Chongqing military commissioner Zhang Jue.

sentences.zh: 國賓詣闕訴冤，詔以玨畀國賓，使復其父仇。

translations.literal: Guobin came to court to plead his grievance; an edict handed Jue over to Guobin and let him avenge his father.
translations.idiomatic: Guobin came to court to plead his grievance; an edict handed Jue over to Guobin and let him avenge his father.

sentences.zh: 玨時在京兆，聞之自經死。

translations.literal: Jue was then at Jingzhao; on hearing this he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Jue was then at Jingzhao; on hearing this he hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 國賓請贖還瀘州軍民之為俘者，從之。

translations.literal: Guobin requested redemption of Luzhou soldiers and civilians held captive; granted.
translations.idiomatic: Guobin asked to redeem Luzhou soldiers and civilians held captive; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 日本國殺國使杜世忠等，征東元帥忻都、洪茶丘請自率兵往討，廷議姑少緩之。

translations.literal: Japan had killed the envoy Du Shizhong and others; Eastern Campaign marshal Xindu and Hong Chajiu asked to lead troops themselves to punish them; court deliberation decided to defer the matter for the moment.
translations.idiomatic: Japan had killed the envoy Du Shizhong and others; Eastern Campaign marshal Xindu and Hong Chajiu asked to lead troops themselves to punish them, but court deliberation decided to defer the matter for the moment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔諭真人祁誌誠等焚毀《道藏》偽妄經文及板。

translations.literal: On bingshen day an edict instructed Perfect Man Qi Zhicheng and others to burn spurious passages in the 《Daoist Canon》 and the blocks used to print them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict instructed Perfect Man Qi Zhicheng and others to burn spurious passages in the 《Daoist Canon》 and the blocks used to print them.

sentences.zh: 庚子，阿裏海牙及納速剌丁招緬國及洞蠻降臣，詔就軍前定錄其功以聞。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Ala Haiya and Nasir al-Din recruited Burma and cave-man tribes to submit; an edict ordered their merits to be recorded and reported at the army front.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Ala Haiya and Nasir al-Din recruited Burma and cave-man tribes to submit; an edict ordered their merits recorded and reported at the army front.

sentences.zh: 江淮行省左丞夏貴請老，從之，仍官其子孫。

translations.literal: Huai-Jiang branch secretariat left associate Xia Gui requested retirement; granted, and his sons and grandsons were given office.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-Jiang branch secretariat left associate Xia Gui requested retirement; the request was granted, and his sons and grandsons were given office.

sentences.zh: 合剌所部和州等城為叛兵所掠者，賜鈔給之，仍免其民差役三年。

translations.literal: For Qara's command and cities such as He Prefecture that had been plundered by rebel troops, paper currency was granted for relief, and the people's corvée was remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: For Qara's command and cities such as He Prefecture that rebel troops had plundered, paper currency was granted for relief and the people's corvée was remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 發侍衛軍三千浚通州運糧河。

translations.literal: Three thousand palace guard troops were dispatched to dredge Tongzhou's grain transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand palace guard troops were dispatched to dredge Tongzhou's grain transport canal.

sentences.zh: 畏吾戶居河西界者，令其屯田。

translations.literal: Uyghur households dwelling on the Hexi frontier were ordered to garrison-farm.
translations.idiomatic: Uyghur households dwelling on the Hexi frontier were ordered to garrison-farm.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以廣中民不聊生，召右丞塔出、左丞呂師夔廷詰壞民之由，命也的迷失、賈居貞行宣慰司往撫之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, because the people of Guangzhong could not make a living, right associate Tachu and left associate Lu Shikui were summoned to court to answer for harming the people; Yeshimishi and Jia Juzhen were ordered to proceed as branch pacification commissioners to soothe the region.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because the people of Guangzhong could not make a living, right associate Tachu and left associate Lu Shikui were summoned to court to answer for harming the people; Yeshimishi and Jia Juzhen were ordered out as branch pacification commissioners to soothe the region.

sentences.zh: 師夔至，廷辯無驗，復令還省治事。

translations.literal: When Shikui arrived, court debate found no proof; he was ordered back to the secretariat to manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Shikui arrived, court debate found no proof, and he was ordered back to the secretariat to manage affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔王相府於諸奧魯市馬二萬六千三百匹。

translations.literal: An edict directed princely chancellor's offices to purchase twenty-six thousand three hundred horses at the various ordu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed princely chancellor's offices to purchase 26,300 horses at the various ordu.

sentences.zh: 遣使代祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王阿八合、那木幹所部，及征日本行省阿剌罕、範文虎等西錦衣、銀鈔、幣帛各有差。

translations.literal: The households under Princes Abaqa and Namukan, and Fan Wenhu and Alaghan of the Japan campaign branch secretariat, were granted Western brocade robes, silver, paper currency, and silks in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The households under Princes Abaqa and Namukan, and Fan Wenhu and Alaghan of the Japan campaign branch secretariat, received Western brocade robes, silver, paper currency, and silks in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 又賜四川貧民及兀剌帶等馬牛羊價鈔。

translations.literal: Paper currency was also granted to Sichuan's poor and for the price of horses, cattle, and sheep to Ulatai and others.
translations.idiomatic: Paper currency was also granted to Sichuan's poor and for the price of horses, cattle, and sheep to Ulatai and others.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，命福建王積翁入領省事，中書省臣以為不可，改戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, on guimao day, Wang Jinweng of Fujian was ordered to enter and take charge of branch secretariat affairs; Central Secretariat officials held this improper, and he was changed to minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao day, Wang Jinweng of Fujian was ordered to take charge of branch secretariat affairs; Central Secretariat officials held this improper, and he was made minister of revenue instead.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 思、播州軍侵鎮遠、黃平界，命李德輝等往視之。

translations.literal: Troops of Si and Bozhou encroached on the borders of Zhenyuan and Huangping; Li Dehui and others were ordered to go and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Troops of Si and Bozhou encroached on the borders of Zhenyuan and Huangping; Li Dehui and others were ordered to go and inspect.

sentences.zh: 罷通政院官不勝任者。

translations.literal: Incompetent officials of the Communications Bureau were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Incompetent officials of the Communications Bureau were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，敕東西兩川發蒙古、漢軍戍魚通、黎、雅。

translations.literal: On bingwu day an order directed Eastern and Western Sichuan to dispatch Mongol and Han troops to garrison Yutong, Li, and Ya.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day an order directed Eastern and Western Sichuan to dispatch Mongol and Han troops to garrison Yutong, Li, and Ya.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，立都功德使司，從二品，掌奏帝師所統僧人並吐番軍民等事。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Directorate of Merit Commissions was established, ranked 2b, in charge of memorializing on Buddhist clergy under the Imperial Preceptor and Tibetan military and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Directorate of Merit Commissions was established at rank 2b, in charge of memorializing on Buddhist clergy under the Imperial Preceptor and Tibetan military and civilians.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔討羅氏鬼國，命以蒙古軍六千，哈剌章軍一萬，西川藥剌海、萬家奴軍萬人，阿裏海牙軍萬人，三道並進。

translations.literal: On jiwei day an edict ordered a campaign against the Luoshi Ghost Country; six thousand Mongol troops, ten thousand Qara Jang troops, ten thousand troops under Yarlaq Hai and Wanjianu of Western Sichuan, and ten thousand troops under Ala Haiya were to advance on three routes together.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict ordered a campaign against the Luoshi Ghost Country; 6,000 Mongol troops, 10,000 Qara Jang troops, 10,000 troops under Yarlaq Hai and Wanjianu of Western Sichuan, and 10,000 troops under Ala Haiya were to advance on three routes together.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，高郵等處饑，賑粟九千四百石。

translations.literal: On guihai day Gaoyou and other places suffered famine; nine thousand four hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Gaoyou and other places suffered famine; 9,400 shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立畏吾境內交鈔提舉司。

translations.literal: On xinwei day an exchange-note superintendency was established within Uyghur territory.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an exchange-note superintendency was established within Uyghur territory.

sentences.zh: 給月脫古思八部屯田牛具。

translations.literal: Plough ox teams were supplied to Tutghus's eight tribes for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Plough ox teams were supplied to Tutghus's eight tribes for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 賜忙古帶等羊馬及皇子南木合下羊馬價。

translations.literal: Sheep and horses were granted to Mangudai and others, and price payments for sheep and horses to Prince Namuqa's household.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep and horses were granted to Mangudai and others, and price payments for sheep and horses to Prince Namuqa's household.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申朔，中書省臣言：「唆都軍士擾民，故南劍等路民復叛。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the renshen new moon, Central Secretariat officials said: "Suodu's soldiers disturbed the people, so the people of Nanjian and other routes rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the renshen new moon, Central Secretariat officials said, "Suodu's soldiers disturbed the people, so the people of Nanjian and other routes rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 及忙古帶往招徠之，民始獲安。

translations.literal: Only when Mangudai went to win them over did the people at last find peace.
translations.idiomatic: Only when Mangudai went to win them over did the people at last find peace.

sentences.zh: 」詔以忙古帶仍行省福州。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Mangudai to continue administering the branch secretariat at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Mangudai to continue administering the branch secretariat at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，南康杜可用叛，命史弼討擒之。

translations.literal: On renyou day Du Keyong of Nankang rebelled; Shi Bi was ordered to campaign against him and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyou day Du Keyong of Nankang rebelled; Shi Bi was ordered to campaign against him and capture him.

sentences.zh: 定杭州宣慰司官四員，以遊顯、管如德、忽都虎、劉宣充之。

translations.literal: The Hangzhou pacification commission was fixed at four officials, with You Xian, Guan Rude, Huduhu, and Liu Xuan appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The Hangzhou pacification commission was fixed at four officials, with You Xian, Guan Rude, Huduhu, and Liu Xuan appointed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，隆興路楊門站復為懷安縣。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Yangmen Station of Longxing Route was again made Huai'an County.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yangmen Station of Longxing Route was again made Huai'an County.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，四川宣慰使也罕的斤請賜海青符，命以二符給之。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Sichuan pacification commissioner Yehandejin requested grant of a gyrfalcon tally; an order directed that two tallies be given him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Sichuan pacification commissioner Yehandejin requested a gyrfalcon tally; an order directed that two tallies be given him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，史弼入朝。

translations.literal: On renwu day Shi Bi came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Shi Bi came to court.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以宋太常樂付太常寺。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Song's court music was handed over to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Song's court music was handed over to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 改泗州靈壁縣仍隸宿州。

translations.literal: Lingbi County of Sizhou was again placed under Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lingbi County of Sizhou was again placed under Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立杭州路金玉總管府。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the Hangzhou Route gold and jade commander-in-chief's headquarters was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Hangzhou Route gold and jade commander-in-chief's headquarters was established.

sentences.zh: 甲午，敕軍戶貧乏者還民籍。

translations.literal: On jiawu day impoverished soldier households were restored to civilian registers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day impoverished soldier households were restored to civilian registers.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以羅佐山道梗，敕阿裏海牙發軍千人戍守。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, because the Luozuo Mountain route was blocked, an order directed Ala Haiya to dispatch one thousand troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, because the Luozuo Mountain route was blocked, an order directed Ala Haiya to dispatch 1,000 troops to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 以隆興、泉州、福建置三省不便，命廷臣集議以聞。

translations.literal: Because placing three branch secretariats at Longxing, Quanzhou, and Fujian was inconvenient, court officials were ordered to assemble and deliberate and report.
translations.idiomatic: Because placing three branch secretariats at Longxing, Quanzhou, and Fujian was inconvenient, court officials were ordered to assemble, deliberate, and report.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諸王只必帖木兒請各投下設官，不從。

translations.literal: On jihai day Prince Jibeq Temür requested that each appanage establish officials; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Prince Jibeq Temür requested that each appanage establish officials; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 庚子，歲星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Jupiter transgressed the Great Star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jupiter transgressed the Great Star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 敕權停百官俸。

translations.literal: An order temporarily suspended official salaries.
translations.idiomatic: An order temporarily suspended official salaries.

sentences.zh: 寧海、益都等四郡霜，真定七郡蟲，皆損桑。

translations.literal: Frost struck four commanderies including Ninghai and Yidu; insects struck seven commanderies of Zhending; all damaged mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: Frost struck four commanderies including Ninghai and Yidu; insects struck seven commanderies of Zhending; all damaged mulberry.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑朔，樞密院調兵六百守居庸南、北口。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the xinchou new moon, the Privy Council transferred six hundred troops to garrison the south and north passes of Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinchou new moon, the Privy Council transferred 600 troops to garrison the south and north passes of Juyong.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，作行宮於察罕腦兒。

translations.literal: On jiachen day a traveling palace was built at Chaghan Na'ur.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day a traveling palace was built at Chaghan Na'ur.

sentences.zh: 丙午，升沙州為路。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Shazhou was promoted to a route.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Shazhou was promoted to a route.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，括沙州戶丁，定常賦，其富戶余田令所戍漢軍耕種。

translations.literal: On guichou day Shazhou household males were registered and regular levies fixed; surplus fields of wealthy households were ordered given to garrison Han troops to cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Shazhou household males were registered and regular levies fixed; surplus fields of wealthy households were ordered given to garrison Han troops to cultivate.

sentences.zh: 詔雲南行省發四川軍萬人，命藥剌海領之，與前所遣將同征緬國。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to dispatch ten thousand Sichuan troops, placed under Yarlaq Hai's command, to campaign against Burma together with the generals previously sent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to dispatch 10,000 Sichuan troops under Yarlaq Hai to campaign against Burma together with the generals previously sent.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王春以民饑，乞貸糧萬石，從之。

translations.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because his people suffered famine, requested a loan of ten thousand shi of grain; granted.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because his people suffered famine, requested a loan of 10,000 shi of grain; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 福建行省移泉州。

translations.literal: The Fujian branch secretariat moved to Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian branch secretariat moved to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，汀、漳叛賊廖得勝等伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Ting and Zhang rebels Liao Desheng and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Ting and Zhang rebels Liao Desheng and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 造船三千艘，敕耽羅發材木給之。

translations.literal: Three thousand ships were to be built; an order directed Tamna to supply timber.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand ships were to be built; an order directed Tamna to supply timber.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賜諸王別乞帖木兒銀印。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Prince Beg Temür was granted a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince Beg Temür was granted a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜國師掌教所印。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Imperial Preceptor's teaching office was granted a seal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Imperial Preceptor's teaching office was granted a seal.

sentences.zh: 賞伯顏將士戰功銀二萬八千七百五十兩。

translations.literal: Twenty-eight thousand seven hundred fifty taels of silver were granted to reward the battle merit of Bayan's officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: 28,750 taels of silver were granted to reward the battle merit of Bayan's officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 真定、咸平、忻州、漣、海、邳、宿諸州郡蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts struck the prefectures and commanderies of Zhending, Xianping, Xin Prefecture, Lian, Hai, Pi, and Su.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck the prefectures and commanderies of Zhending, Xianping, Xin Prefecture, Lian, Hai, Pi, and Su.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，廣東宣慰使帖木兒不花言：「諸軍官宜一例遷轉。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the xinchou new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Tiemur Buqa said: "Military officers should all rotate by a single rule.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the xinchou new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Tiemur Buqa said, "Military officers should all rotate by a single rule.

sentences.zh: 江淮郡縣，首亂者誅，沒其家。

translations.literal: In Huai-Jiang prefectures and counties, the chief instigators of disorder were to be executed and their households confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In Huai-Jiang prefectures and counties, the chief instigators of disorder were to be executed and their households confiscated.

sentences.zh: 官豪隱庇佃民，不供徭役，宜別立籍。

translations.literal: Officials and powerful families who concealed tenant commoners and did not supply corvée should have separate registers established.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and powerful families who concealed tenant commoners and did not supply corvée should have separate registers established.

sentences.zh: 各萬戶軍交參重役，宜發還元翼。

translations.literal: Household troops of the various wanhu who were mixed in heavy corvée should be sent back to their original wings.
translations.idiomatic: Household troops of the various wanhu who were mixed in heavy corvée should be sent back to their original wings.

sentences.zh: 」詔中書省、樞密院、翰林院集議以聞。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Hanlin Academy to assemble and deliberate and report.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Hanlin Academy to assemble, deliberate, and report.

sentences.zh: 敕思州安撫司還舊治。

translations.literal: An order directed the Si Prefecture pacification commission to return to its former seat.
translations.idiomatic: An order directed the Si Prefecture pacification commission to return to its former seat.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太陰犯房距星。

translations.literal: On wushen day the moon transgressed the Determining Star of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed the Determining Star of Fang.

sentences.zh: 以高麗國初置驛，站民乏食，命給糧一歲，仍禁使臣往來，勿求索飲食。

translations.literal: Because Goryeo had first established relay stations and relay households lacked food, an order directed that grain be supplied for one year and envoys forbidden to come and go demanding food and drink.
translations.idiomatic: Because Goryeo had first established relay stations and relay households lacked food, an order directed grain supplied for one year and forbade envoys to come and go demanding food and drink.

sentences.zh: 己酉，立行省於京兆，以前安西相李德輝為參知政事，兼領錢谷事。

translations.literal: On jiyou day a branch secretariat was established at Jingzhao, with the former Anxi chancellor Li Dehui as associate administrator concurrently in charge of revenue and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day a branch secretariat was established at Jingzhao, with the former Anxi chancellor Li Dehui as associate administrator concurrently in charge of revenue and grain.

sentences.zh: 徙泉州行省於隆興。

translations.literal: The Quanzhou branch secretariat moved to Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: The Quanzhou branch secretariat moved to Longxing.

sentences.zh: 以禿古滅軍劫食火拙畏吾城禾，民饑，命官給驛馬之費，仍免其賦稅三年。

translations.literal: Because Tuganem's troops had plundered grain in the Huozhuo Uyghur city, and the people suffered famine, an order directed that relay-horse expenses be supplied by the state and their taxes remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Because Tuganem's troops had plundered grain in the Huozhuo Uyghur city and the people suffered famine, an order directed that relay-horse expenses be supplied by the state and their taxes remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，發衛兵八百治沙嶺橋，敕毋踐民田。

translations.literal: On jiayin day eight hundred guard troops were dispatched to repair Shaling Bridge; an order forbade trampling civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day 800 guard troops were dispatched to repair Shaling Bridge; an order forbade trampling civilian fields.

sentences.zh: 戊午，從阿合馬言，以參知政事郝禎、耿仁並為中書左丞；

translations.literal: On wuwu day, following Ahmad's recommendation, associate administrators Hao Zhen and Geng Ren were both made left vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, following Ahmad's recommendation, associate administrators Hao Zhen and Geng Ren were both made left vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 用姚演言，開膠東河及收集逃民屯田漣、海。

translations.literal: At Yao Yan's recommendation, the Jiaodong canal was opened and fugitive commoners were gathered for garrison farming at Lian and Hai.
translations.idiomatic: At Yao Yan's recommendation, the Jiaodong canal was opened and fugitive commoners were gathered for garrison farming at Lian and Hai.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣安南國王子倪還。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Annam king's son Ni Huan was sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Annam king's son Ni Huan was sent home.

sentences.zh: 括蒙古軍成丁者。

translations.literal: Adult males of the Mongol army were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Adult males of the Mongol army were registered.

sentences.zh: 敕亦來等率萬人入羅氏鬼國，如其不附，則入討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yilai and others to lead ten thousand men into Luoshi Ghost Country; if they did not submit, they were to enter and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yilai and others to lead ten thousand men into Luoshi Ghost Country; if the country did not submit, they were to enter and suppress it.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷江南財賦總管府。

translations.literal: On yichou day the Jiangnan revenue chief commissioner's office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Jiangnan revenue chief commissioner's office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，並大都鹽運司入河間為一，仍減汰冗員。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Dadu salt transport commission was merged with Hejian into one office, and redundant personnel were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Dadu salt transport commission was merged with Hejian into one office, and redundant personnel were cut.

sentences.zh: 割建康民二萬戶種稻，歲輸釀米三萬石，官為運至京師。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand households of Jiankang commoners were assigned to grow rice, yielding thirty thousand shi of brewing rice annually, transported to the capital by the state.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand Jiankang households were assigned to grow rice, yielding 30,000 shi of brewing rice each year for transport to the capital by the state.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔括前願從軍者及張世傑潰軍，使征日本。

translations.literal: On wuchen day an edict ordered the registration of those who had previously volunteered for service and Zhang Shijie's routed troops, to be sent to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered the registration of earlier volunteers for service and Zhang Shijie's routed troops for the campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 命範文虎等招集避罪附宋蒙古、回回等軍。

translations.literal: Fan Wenhu and others were ordered to gather Mongol, Muslim, and other troops who had taken refuge with Song to avoid punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu and others were ordered to gather Mongol, Muslim, and other troops who had joined Song to avoid punishment.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣中使咬難歷江南名山訪求高士，且命持香幣詣信州龍虎山、臨江閣皂山、建康三茅山，皆設醮。

translations.literal: On jisi day a palace envoy Yanan was dispatched to visit famous mountains in Jiangnan seeking recluses, and also ordered to carry incense and silks to Mount Longhu in Xin Prefecture, Mount Gezao in Linjiang, and Mount Sanmao in Jiankang, with libation rites established at each.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day palace envoy Yanan was sent to visit famous mountains in Jiangnan seeking recluses, and also to carry incense and silks to Mount Longhu in Xin Prefecture, Mount Gezao in Linjiang, and Mount Sanmao in Jiankang, with libation rites at each.

sentences.zh: 賜阿赤黑等及怯薛都等戰功銀鈔，賜招收散毛等洞官吏衣段。

translations.literal: Aqchihei and others and Keshigde and others were granted silver and paper currency for battle merit; officials of the Sanmao and other cave districts who had been recruited to submit were granted clothing and fabrics.
translations.idiomatic: Aqchihei, Keshigde, and others received silver and paper currency for battle merit; officials of the Sanmao and other cave districts recruited to submit received clothing and fabrics.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午朔，蕭簡等十人歷河南五路，擅招闌遺戶，事覺，謫其為首者從軍自效，餘皆杖之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengwu new moon: Xiao Jian and ten others had travelled through the five routes of Henan, privately recruiting escaped households; when the matter was discovered, the ringleaders were demoted to serve in the army to redeem themselves and the rest were caned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengwu new moon, Xiao Jian and ten others had travelled through the five Henan routes privately recruiting escaped households; when the matter came out, the ringleaders were demoted to army service to redeem themselves and the rest were caned.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，改蒙古侍衛總管府為蒙古侍衛親軍都指揮使司。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Mongol Guard commander's office was changed to the Mongol Guard Household Army metropolitan commanderate.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Mongol Guard commander's office was made the Mongol Guard Household Army metropolitan commanderate.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太陰犯心東星。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the moon transgressed the eastern star of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon transgressed the eastern star of Xin.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，唆都請招三佛齊等八國，不從。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Suodu requested to summon the submission of Samboja and seven other states; this was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Suodu asked to summon the submission of Samboja and seven other states; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 鎮守南劍路萬戶呂宗海竊兵亡去，詔追捕之。

translations.literal: Wanhu Lü Zonghai, garrisoning Nanjian Route, stole troops and fled; an edict ordered him pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Wanhu Lü Zonghai, garrisoning Nanjian Route, stole troops and fled; an edict ordered him pursued.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，占城、馬八兒國皆遣使奉表稱臣，貢寶物犀象。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Champa and Ma'bar both dispatched envoys presenting memorials declaring themselves subjects and tribute of precious objects, rhinoceros horn, and elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Champa and Ma'bar both sent envoys with memorials declaring themselves subjects and tribute of precious objects, rhinoceros horn, and elephants.

sentences.zh: 以前所括願從軍者為軍，付茶忽領之征日本。

translations.literal: Those previously registered as volunteers for service were made troops and placed under Chahu to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Those previously registered as volunteers for service were made troops and placed under Chahu for the campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，許衡致仕，官其子師可為懷孟路總管，以便侍養。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Xu Heng retired from office; his son Shike was appointed route commander of Huaimeng so he could serve and support him.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Xu Heng retired; his son Shike was made route commander of Huaimeng so he could serve and support him.

sentences.zh: 納碧玉盞六、白玉盞十五於太廟。

translations.literal: Six jadeite cups and fifteen white jade cups were submitted to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Six jadeite cups and fifteen white jade cups were submitted to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賜西平王所部糧。

translations.literal: On guisi day grain was granted to the forces under the Prince of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day grain was granted to the forces under the Prince of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，高麗王王春來朝，且言將益兵三萬征日本。

translations.literal: On wuxu day King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court and said he would add thirty thousand troops to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day King Wang Chun of Goryeo came to court and said he would add 30,000 troops to the campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 以範文虎、忻都、洪茶丘為中書右丞，李庭、張拔突為參知政事，並行中書省事。

translations.literal: Fan Wenhu, Xindu, and Hong Chajiu were made right vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat; Li Ting and Zhang Batuo were made associate administrators, all administering Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu, Xindu, and Hong Chajiu were made right vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat; Li Ting and Zhang Batuo were made associate administrators, all administering Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 賜闊裏吉思等鈔，迷裏兀合等羊馬，怯魯憐等牛羊馬價，及東宮位下怯憐口等粟帛。

translations.literal: Paper currency was granted to Kuolijisi and others, sheep and horses to Miliwuge and others, price payments for cattle, sheep, and horses to Qielulian and others, and grain and silks to the keshig households of the Eastern Palace and others.
translations.idiomatic: Paper currency was granted to Kuolijisi and others, sheep and horses to Miliwuge and others, price payments for cattle, sheep, and horses to Qielulian and others, and grain and silks to the Eastern Palace keshig households and others.

sentences.zh: 大都、北京、懷孟、保定、南京、許州、平陽旱，濮州、東平、濟寧、磁州水。

translations.literal: Dadu, Beijing, Huaimeng, Baoding, Nanjing, Xuzhou, and Pingyang suffered drought; Puzhou, Dongping, Jining, and Cizhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu, Beijing, Huaimeng, Baoding, Nanjing, Xuzhou, and Pingyang suffered drought; Puzhou, Dongping, Jining, and Cizhou flooded.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renzi day: the imperial carriage returned from the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day, the Emperor returned from the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，也罕的斤進征斡端。

translations.literal: On renxu day Yehaihan advanced to campaign against Otgon.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Yehaihan advanced to campaign against Otgon.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命沿途廩食和林回軍。

translations.literal: On guihai day orders directed that returning troops from Khara Kulgan be supplied grain at posts along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day orders directed grain supplied at posts along the route to returning troops from Khara Kulgan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰掩右執法，並犯歲星。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the moon eclipsed Right Regulator and also transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon eclipsed Right Regulator and also transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，守庫軍盜庫鈔，八剌合赤分其贓，縱盜遁去，詔誅之。

translations.literal: On yichou day garrison troops guarding the treasury stole treasury notes; Baraqchi divided the booty and let the thieves escape; an edict ordered them executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day garrison troops guarding the treasury stole treasury notes; Baraqchi divided the booty and let the thieves escape; an edict ordered them executed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，羅氏鬼國主阿察及阿裏降，安西王相李德輝遣人偕入覲。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and Ali submitted; Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui sent men to accompany them to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and Ali submitted; Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui sent men to accompany them to audience.

sentences.zh: 賜八剌合赤等羊馬價二萬八千三錠，及禿渾下貧民糧三月。

translations.literal: Sheep and horse price payments of twenty-eight thousand three hundred ingots were granted to Baraqchi and others, and three months' grain to the poor under Tuhun.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep and horse price payments of 28,300 ingots were granted to Baraqchi and others, and three months' grain to the poor under Tuhun.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，塔剌不罕軍與賊力戰者，命給田賞之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengwu day: soldiers of Talabuqan's army who had fought the enemy fiercely were ordered granted land as reward.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on gengwu day, soldiers of Talabuqan's army who had fought fiercely were ordered granted land as reward.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，加高麗國王王春開府儀同三司、中書左丞相、行中書省事。

translations.literal: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was additionally made Grand Preceptor of State with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies, left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat, and administrator of branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was additionally made grand preceptor of state with the ceremonial of the Three Excellencies, left grand councillor of the Central Secretariat, and administrator of branch secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣使括開元等路軍三千征日本。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day envoys were dispatched to register three thousand troops from Kaiyuan and other routes for the campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day envoys were sent to register 3,000 troops from Kaiyuan and other routes for the campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜雲南王忽哥赤印。

translations.literal: On bingzi day a seal was granted to Prince Hokechi of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day a seal was granted to Prince Hokechi of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以湖南兵萬人伐亦奚不薛，亦奚不薛降。

translations.literal: On dingchou day ten thousand Hunan troops were sent to attack Yixibuxue, and Yixibuxue submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day 10,000 Hunan troops were sent against Yixibuxue, and Yixibuxue submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，發兵十萬，命範文虎將之。

translations.literal: On wuyin day one hundred thousand troops were dispatched, and Fan Wenhu was ordered to command them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day 100,000 troops were dispatched, and Fan Wenhu was ordered to command them.

sentences.zh: 賜右丞洪茶丘所將征日本新附軍鈔及甲。

translations.literal: Paper currency and armor were granted to the newly submitted troops under right vice chancellor Hong Chajiu campaigning against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Paper currency and armor were granted to the newly submitted troops under right vice chancellor Hong Chajiu bound for Japan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，立營田提舉司，從五品，俾置司柳林，割諸色戶千三百五十五隸之，官給牛種農具。

translations.literal: On xinsi day a garrison-farming superintendency was established, rank 5b, to be placed at Liulin; one thousand three hundred fifty-five households of various categories were assigned to it, and the state supplied oxen, seed, and farm tools.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day a garrison-farming superintendency was established at rank 5b and placed at Liulin; 1,355 households of various categories were assigned to it, and the state supplied oxen, seed, and farm tools.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔立陜西四川等處行中書省，以不花為右丞，李德輝、汪惟正並左丞。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered the establishment of a branch secretariat in Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other places, with Buhua as right vice chancellor and Li Dehui and Wang Weizheng both as left vice chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered a branch secretariat established in Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other places, with Buhua as right vice chancellor and Li Dehui and Wang Weizheng as left vice chancellors.

sentences.zh: 時德輝已卒。

translations.literal: By this time Dehui had already died.
translations.idiomatic: By this time Dehui had already died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔龍虎山天師張宗演赴闕。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan of Mount Longhu was ordered to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan of Mount Longhu was ordered to court.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命都實窮黃河源。

translations.literal: All darughachis that should be established under the various princes were ordered to come to court, and the princes Azhiji and others were also instructed by edict.
translations.idiomatic: All darughachis due to be posted under the various princes were ordered to court, and princes including Azhiji were notified by edict.

sentences.zh: 己酉，改黃州陽羅堡復隸鄂州。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Yangluo Fort of Huang Prefecture was again placed under E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yangluo Fort of Huang Prefecture was again placed under E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣使代祀嶽瀆后土。

translations.literal: On xinhai day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar on the Emperor's behalf.

sentences.zh: 壬子，高麗王王春遣使言日本犯其邊境，乞兵追之，詔以戍金州隘口軍五百付之。

translations.literal: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent envoys saying Japan had violated his border and asking for troops to pursue them; an edict granted him five hundred troops garrisoning the Jinzhou pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day King Wang Chun of Goryeo reported that Japan had raided his border and asked for troops to pursue them; an edict gave him five hundred troops from the Jinzhou pass garrison.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕幸漷州。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the imperial carriage visited Hu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Emperor visited Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改符寶局為典瑞監，收天下諸司職印。

translations.literal: The Seal Bureau was changed to the Directorate of Sacred Regalia, and the official seals of offices throughout the realm were collected.
translations.idiomatic: The seal bureau was renamed the directorate of sacred regalia, and official seals from offices throughout the realm were collected.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，制以六祖李全祐嗣五祖李居壽祭鬥。

translations.literal: On dingsi day a decree made sixth-generation Li Quanyou succeed fifth-generation Li Jushou in sacrificing to the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day a decree made Li Quanyou of the sixth generation succeed Li Jushou of the fifth generation in sacrificing to the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，邵武民高日新據龍樓寨為亂，擒之。

translations.literal: On guihai day Gao Rixin of Shaowu, holding Longlou Stockade in rebellion, was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Gao Rixin of Shaowu, who had seized Longlou Stockade in rebellion, was captured.

sentences.zh: 賞忻都等戰功，賜征日本諸軍鈔。

translations.literal: Xindu and others were rewarded for battle merit, and the armies campaigning against Japan were granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Xindu and others were rewarded for battle merit, and troops bound for Japan received paper money.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，發侍衛軍四千完正殿。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuchen day four thousand guard troops were dispatched to complete the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen day four thousand guard troops were sent to finish the main hall.

sentences.zh: 賜征日本善射軍及高麗火長水軍鈔四千錠。

translations.literal: The armies campaigning against Japan, the skilled archers, and the Goryeo squad leaders and naval troops were granted four thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Troops bound for Japan, skilled archers, and Goryeo squad leaders and naval forces received four thousand ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕幸柳林。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the imperial carriage visited Willow Grove.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Emperor visited Willow Grove.

sentences.zh: 高麗王王春以尚主，乞改宣命益駙馬二字。

translations.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, having married an imperial princess, asked that the words "imperial son-in-law" be added to his patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, having married an imperial princess, asked that the words "imperial son-in-law" be added to his appointment patent.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「可。

translations.idiomatic: " On yihai day an edict ordered Tamna's newly built ships turned over to Hong Chajiu for the expedition.

sentences.zh: 詔以刑徒減死者付忻都為軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered convicts whose death sentences had been commuted handed over to Xindu as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered convicts whose death sentences had been commuted assigned to Xindu as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 揚州火，發米七百八十三石賑被災之家。

translations.literal: Fire struck Yangzhou; seven hundred eighty-three shi of grain were issued to relieve affected households.
translations.idiomatic: Fire struck Yangzhou; seven hundred eighty-three shi of grain were issued to households affected by the disaster.

sentences.zh: 詔諭範文虎等以征日本之意，仍申嚴軍律。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Fan Wenhu and others on the intent of the campaign against Japan and again strictly enforced military law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed Fan Wenhu and others on the purpose of the campaign against Japan and again tightened military discipline.

sentences.zh: 立上都留守司。

translations.literal: The Shangdu garrison commissionerate was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangdu garrison commissionerate was established.

sentences.zh: 升敘州為路，隸安西省。

translations.literal: Xu Prefecture was promoted to a route and placed under Anxi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture was promoted to a route and placed under Anxi Province.

sentences.zh: 移潭州省治鄂州，徙湖南宣慰司於潭州。

translations.literal: The Hunan provincial seat was moved from Tanzhou to E Prefecture, and the Hunan pacification commission was moved to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan provincial seat was moved from Tanzhou to E Prefecture, and the Hunan pacification commission was relocated to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改畏吾斷事官為北庭都護府，升從二品。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Uyghur judicial office was changed to the Beiting Protectorate and raised to rank two subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Uyghur judicial office was made the Beiting Protectorate and raised to rank two subordinate.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，征日本國軍啟行。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the army campaigning against Japan set out.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the army bound for Japan set out.

sentences.zh: 浙東饑，發粟千二百七十餘石賑之。

translations.literal: Famine struck eastern Zhe; more than one thousand two hundred seventy shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Zhe suffered famine; more than one thousand two hundred seventy shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 己丑，發肅州等處軍民鑿渠溉田。

translations.literal: On jichou day troops and civilians of Suzhou and other places were dispatched to dig canals and irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day troops and civilians in Suzhou and elsewhere were sent to dig canals and irrigate fields.

sentences.zh: 給征日本軍衣甲、弓矢、海青符。

translations.literal: The army campaigning against Japan was supplied with clothing, armor, bows and arrows, and sea-hawk tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Troops bound for Japan were supplied with clothing, armor, bows and arrows, and sea-hawk tallies.

sentences.zh: 敕通政院官渾都與郭漢傑整治水驛，自敘州至荊南凡十九站，增戶二千一百、船二百十二艘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Transmission Bureau official Huntun and Guo Hanjie to put the water courier stations in order; from Xu Prefecture to Jingnan there were nineteen stations in all, with two thousand one hundred households and two hundred twelve boats added.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered transmission bureau official Huntun and Guo Hanjie to put the water courier stations in order from Xu Prefecture to Jingnan—nineteen stations in all—with two thousand one hundred households and two hundred twelve boats added.

sentences.zh: 詔諭烏瑣納空等毋擾羅氏鬼國，違者令國主阿利具以名聞。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Wusuo Nakong and others not to disturb Luoshi Ghost Country; violators were to be reported by name to the country lord Aliju.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed Wusuo Nakong and others not to disturb Luoshi Ghost Country; violators were to be reported by name to the country lord Aliju.

sentences.zh: 福建省左丞蒲壽庚言：「詔造海船二百艘，今成者五十，民實艱苦。

translations.literal: Fujian Province left associate Pu Shougeng said: "An edict ordered two hundred seagoing ships built; only fifty are finished, and the people are truly in hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Province left associate Pu Shougeng said, "An edict ordered two hundred seagoing ships built, but only fifty are finished and the people are truly suffering.

sentences.zh: 」詔止之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the work stopped.

sentences.zh: 乙未，貞懿順聖昭天睿文光應皇后弘吉剌氏崩。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Empress Chabi of the Hongjira clan, styled Empress of Graceful Devotion, Sagely Compliance, Illuminating Heaven, Wise in Letters, and Responsive to Radiance, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Empress Chabi of the Hongjira clan died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 詔三茅山三十八代宗師蔣宗瑛赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict summoned Jiang Zongying, thirty-eighth-generation patriarch of Mount Sanmao, to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Jiang Zongying, thirty-eighth-generation patriarch of Mount Sanmao, to court.

sentences.zh: 遣丹八八合赤等詣東海及濟源廟修佛事。

translations.literal: Danbabaike and others were dispatched to the Donghai and Jiyuan temples to perform Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: Danbabaike and others were sent to the Donghai and Jiyuan temples to perform Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 以中書右丞、行江東道宣慰使阿剌罕為中書左丞相，行中書省事，江西道宣慰使兼招討使也的迷失參知政事，行中書省事。

translations.literal: Right associate of the Central Secretariat and acting Jiangdong Circuit pacification commissioner Alaghan was made left grand councillor and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs; Jiangxi Circuit pacification commissioner and concurrent campaign commissioner Yeshimishi was made associate administrator and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Right associate of the Central Secretariat and acting Jiangdong Circuit pacification commissioner Alaghan was made left grand councillor and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs; Jiangxi Circuit pacification commissioner and concurrent campaign commissioner Yeshimishi was made associate administrator and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 以遼陽、懿、蓋、北京、大定諸州旱，免今年租稅之半。

translations.literal: Because Liaoyang, Yi, Gai, Bejing, and Dading and other prefectures suffered drought, half of this year's rent and tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Liaoyang, Yi, Gai, Beijing, Dading, and other prefectures suffered drought, half of that year's rent and tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，許衡卒。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuxu day Xu Heng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu day Xu Heng died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，敕黃平棣安西行省，鎮遠隸潭州行省，各遣兵戍守。

translations.literal: On jihai day an edict ordered the Anxi branch secretariat for Huang, Ping, and Di and Zhenyuan placed under the Tanzhou branch secretariat; each was to dispatch troops to garrison and defend.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict ordered the Anxi branch secretariat for Huang, Ping, and Di and Zhenyuan, now under the Tanzhou branch secretariat, each to dispatch garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命天師張宗演即宮中奏赤章於天七晝夜。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan was ordered to perform red writ petitions to Heaven in the palace for seven days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan was ordered to perform red writ petitions to Heaven in the palace for seven days and nights.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor went to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，升軍器監為三品。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the Arms Directorate was raised to rank three.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the arms directorate was raised to rank three.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，立登聞鼓院，許有冤者撾鼓以聞。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Petition Drum Court was established, permitting those with grievances to strike the drum and be heard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the petition drum court was established, allowing those with grievances to strike the drum and be heard.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，益雲南軍征合剌章。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day Yunnan forces were increased to campaign against Helazhang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinwei day Yunnan forces were reinforced for the campaign against Helazhang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復頒中外官吏俸。

translations.literal: On guiyou day official salaries at court and throughout the realm were again issued.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day official salaries at court and throughout the realm were restored.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，通、泰二州饑，發粟二萬一千六百石賑之。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Tong and Tai Prefectures suffered famine; twenty-one thousand six hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Tong and Tai Prefectures suffered famine; twenty-one thousand six hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，置蒙古漢人新附軍總管。

translations.literal: On wuzi day a commander-in-chief for Mongol, Han, and newly submitted armies was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day a commander-in-chief for Mongol, Han, and newly submitted armies was established.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命太原五戶絲就輸太原。

translations.literal: On jiawu day an edict ordered Taiyuan's tribute silk delivered directly to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict ordered Taiyuan's tribute silk delivered directly to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 自太和嶺至別十八里置新驛三十。

translations.literal: From Taihe Ridge to Bie Shibali thirty new courier stations were established.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty new courier stations were set up from Taihe Ridge to Bie Shibali.

sentences.zh: 賜征日本河西軍等鈔。

translations.literal: The Hexi army campaigning against Japan and others were granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi troops bound for Japan and others received paper money.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，禁西北邊回回諸人越境為商。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guimao day Muslims along the northwest frontier were forbidden to cross the border to trade.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao day Muslims along the northwest frontier were forbidden to cross the border to trade.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣使賑瓜、沙州饑。

translations.literal: On jiachen day envoys were dispatched to relieve famine in Guazhou and Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day envoys were sent to relieve famine in Guazhou and Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，罷霍州畏兀按察司。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Huozhou Uyghur Surveillance Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Huozhou Uyghur surveillance commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禁甘肅瓜、沙等州為酒。

translations.literal: On jiyou day wine-making was forbidden in Gansu, Guazhou, Shazhou, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day wine-making was forbidden in Gansu, Guazhou, Shazhou, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免耽羅國今歲入貢白纻。

translations.literal: On renzi day Tamna was exempted from this year's tribute of white ramie.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Tamna was exempted from that year's tribute of white ramie.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以烏蒙阿謀宣撫司隸雲南行省。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the Wumeng Amou Pacification Commission was placed under the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Wumeng Amou pacification commission was placed under the Yunnan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯右執法。

translations.literal: Jupiter transited the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter transited the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 庚申，嚴鬻人之禁，乏食者量加賑貸。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the prohibition on selling persons was strictly enforced, and those lacking food were given relief according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the ban on selling persons was strictly enforced, and those without food received measured relief.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔括契丹戶。

translations.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered a registration of Khitan households.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered Khitan households registered.

sentences.zh: 敕耽羅國達魯花赤塔兒赤，禁高麗全羅等處田獵擾民者。

translations.literal: An edict to Tamna darughachi Targhachi forbade hunting in Goryeo's Jeolla and other districts that disturbed the people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to Tamna darughachi Targhachi forbade hunting in Goryeo's Jeolla and other districts that disturbed the people.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，敕賽典赤、火尼赤分管烏木、拔都怯兒等八處民戶。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingyin day an edict ordered Sayyid Ajall and Huonichi separately to administer the households of eight places including Wumu and Baduqi'er.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin day an edict ordered Sayyid Ajall and Huonichi to administer separately the households of eight districts including Wumu and Baduqi'er.

sentences.zh: 謙州織工百四十二戶貧甚，以粟給之，其所鬻妻子官與贖還。

translations.literal: One hundred forty-two weaving households of Qianzhou were extremely poor; grain was given them, and wives and children they had sold were redeemed and returned by the government.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred forty-two weaving households in Qianzhou were destitute; grain was issued to them, and wives and children they had sold were redeemed and returned by the government.

sentences.zh: 以太原新附軍五千屯田甘州。

translations.literal: Five thousand newly submitted troops from Taiyuan were sent to garrison-farm at Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand newly submitted troops from Taiyuan were sent to garrison-farm at Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以按察司所劾羨余糧四萬八千石餉軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou day forty-eight thousand shi of surplus grain impeached by the surveillance commission were used to feed the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day forty-eight thousand shi of surplus grain exposed by the surveillance commission were used to feed the army.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以順慶路隸四川東道宣慰司。

translations.literal: On jimao day Shunqing Route was placed under the Sichuan East Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Shunqing Route was placed under the Sichuan East Circuit pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 安西等處軍站，凡和顧和買，與民均役。

translations.literal: At military courier stations in Anxi and other places, all labor requisitions and government purchases were to be shared equally with the people.
translations.idiomatic: At military courier stations in Anxi and elsewhere, all labor requisitions and government purchases were to be shared equally with the people.

sentences.zh: 增陜西營田糧十萬石，以充常費。

translations.literal: Shaanxi garrison-farm grain was increased by one hundred thousand shi to meet regular expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi garrison-farm grain was increased by one hundred thousand shi for regular expenses.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命耽羅戍力田以自給。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered Tamna garrison troops to farm for their own support.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered Tamna garrison troops to farm for their own support.

sentences.zh: 日本行省臣遣使來言：「大軍駐巨濟島，至對馬島獲島人，言太宰府西六十里舊有戍軍已調出戰，宜乘虛搗之。

translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Japan route secretariat sent word: "The main army is on Gyeongju Island; at Tsushima they captured islanders who said that sixty li west of Dazaifu a garrison force had already been called out to battle—it would be well to strike while the place is empty.

translations.idiomatic: " On guiwei day the Central Secretariat was ordered to calculate government outlays and annual receipts from the Lian and Hai garrison farms under Yao Yan; if feasible they would continue, otherwise they would be abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，放乞赤所招獵戶七千為民。

translations.literal: On dinghai day seven thousand hunter households recruited by Qichi were released as civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day seven thousand hunter households recruited by Qichi were released as civilians.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以阿剌罕有疾，詔阿塔海統率軍馬征日本。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, because Alaghan was ill, an edict ordered Atahai to command the army and horses campaigning against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, because Alaghan was ill, an edict ordered Atahai to take command of the army campaigning against Japan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，高麗國王王春言，本國置驛四十，民畜雕弊，敕並為二十站，仍給馬價八百錠。

translations.literal: On renchen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo said his country had established forty courier stations and the people and livestock were exhausted; an edict combined them into twenty stations and also granted eight hundred ingots for horse costs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day King Wang Chun of Goryeo said his country had forty courier stations and the people and livestock were exhausted; an edict reduced them to twenty stations and granted eight hundred ingots for horse costs.

sentences.zh: 奉使木剌由國苫思丁至占城船壞，使人來言，乞給舟糧及益兵，詔給米一千四百餘石。
