translations.idiomatic: Suraman and others, envoys to Musur, reached Champa with their ship wrecked; they sent men to ask for boats, grain, and reinforcements; an edict granted more than one thousand four hundred shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 以中書左丞忽都帖木兒為中書右丞，行中書省事；

translations.literal: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Hudutemür was made right associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Hudutemür was made right associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of Central Secretariat affairs;

sentences.zh: 御史中丞、行御史臺事忽剌出為中書左丞，行尚書省事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief and acting censorate commissioner Hulachu was made left associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of the Ministry of Works affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief and acting censorate commissioner Hulachu was made left associate of the Central Secretariat and placed in charge of Ministry of Works affairs.

sentences.zh: 賜皇子南木合所部工匠羊馬價鈔。

translations.literal: Paper money for sheep and horse costs was granted to the artisans under Prince Namkha.
translations.idiomatic: Paper money for sheep and horse costs was granted to artisans under Prince Namkha.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，命萬戶綦公直分宣慰使劉恩所將屯肅州漢兵千人，入別十八里，以嘗過西川兵百人為向導。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the jiawu new moon, wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to detach one thousand Han troops garrisoned at Suzhou under pacification commissioner Liu En and enter Bie Shibali, with one hundred soldiers who had once passed through West Sichuan as guides.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jiawu new moon, wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to detach one thousand Han troops garrisoned at Suzhou under pacification commissioner Liu En and enter Bie Shibali, guided by one hundred soldiers who had once passed through West Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，敕甘州置和中所，以給兵糧。

translations.literal: On dingyou day an edict ordered a grain office established at Ganzhou to supply military grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered a grain office set up at Ganzhou to supply military grain.

sentences.zh: 京兆四川分置行省於河西。

translations.literal: The Jingzhao and Sichuan branch secretariats were separately established west of the river at Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: Separate Jingzhao and Sichuan branch secretariats were established west of the river at Hexi.

sentences.zh: 己亥，阿剌罕卒。

translations.literal: On jihai day Alaghan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Alaghan died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，括回回炮手散居他郡者，悉令赴南京屯田。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Muslim catapult makers scattered in other prefectures were all ordered to go to Nanjing to garrison-farm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Muslim catapult makers scattered in other prefectures were all ordered to Nanjing to garrison-farm.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯房距星。

translations.literal: On guimao day the moon transited the distance star of the Fang mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transited the distance star of the Fang mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以忻都戍大和嶺所將蒙古軍還，復令漢軍戍守。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, because the Mongol troops Xindu had garrisoned at Dahe Ridge were returning, Han troops were again ordered to garrison and defend.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, with the Mongol troops Xindu had garrisoned at Dahe Ridge returning, Han troops were again ordered to garrison the post.

sentences.zh: 以松州知州仆散禿哥前後射虎萬計，賜號萬虎將軍。

translations.literal: Because Songzhou prefect Pusantuoge had shot tigers numbering in the tens of thousands before and after, he was granted the title General of Ten Thousand Tigers.
translations.idiomatic: Because Songzhou prefect Pusantuoge had killed tigers by the tens of thousands over the years, he was granted the title General of Ten Thousand Tigers.

sentences.zh: 賜貴赤合八兒禿所招和、真、滁等戶二千八百二十，俾自領之。

translations.literal: Granted to guichi Heba'ertu the two thousand eight hundred twenty households of He, Zhen, Chu, and other places he had recruited, letting him administer them himself.
translations.idiomatic: The 2,820 households of He, Zhen, Chu, and other places recruited by guichi Heba'ertu were granted to him to administer himself.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，唆都征占城，賜駝蓬以辟瘴毒。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Suodu campaigned against Champa and was granted a camel-hair canopy to ward off miasma.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Suodu campaigned against Champa and received a camel-hair canopy to ward off miasma.

sentences.zh: 占城國來貢象犀。

translations.literal: Champa sent tribute of elephants and rhinoceros.
translations.idiomatic: Champa sent tribute of elephants and rhinoceros.

sentences.zh: 命天師張宗演等即壽寧宮奏赤章於天，凡五晝夜。

translations.literal: Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan and others were ordered to perform red rituals to Heaven at Shouning Palace for five days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan and others were ordered to perform red rituals to Heaven at Shouning Palace for five days and nights.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子朔，招討使方文言擇守令、崇祀典、戢奸吏、禁盜賊、治軍旅、獎忠義六事，詔廷臣及諸老議舉行之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiazi new moon: pacification commissioner Fang Wen spoke on six matters — selecting prefects and magistrates, honoring sacrificial rites, restraining corrupt officials, banning banditry, regulating troops, and rewarding loyalty and righteousness; an edict ordered court officials and elders to discuss and implement them.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiazi new moon: pacification commissioner Fang Wen spoke on six matters — selecting prefects and magistrates, honoring sacrificial rites, restraining corrupt officials, banning banditry, regulating troops, and rewarding loyalty and righteousness; an edict ordered court officials and elders to discuss and carry them out.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，熒惑犯諸侯西第三星。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Mars transgressed the third star west of the Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Mars transgressed the third star west of the Feudal Lords.

sentences.zh: 庚午，忙古帶為中書右丞，行中書省事。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Mangudai was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat and directed Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Mangudai was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat and directed Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，敕隆興行省參政劉合拔兒禿，凡金谷造作專領之。

translations.literal: On xinwei day an edict directed Longxing Branch Secretariat associate administrator Liu Heba'ertu to take exclusive charge of all revenue, grain, and construction.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict directed Longxing Branch Secretariat associate administrator Liu Heba'ertu to take exclusive charge of all revenue, grain, and construction.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，甘州凡諸投下戶，依民例應站役。

translations.literal: On yihai day all appanage households in Ganzhou were required to perform relay service according to commoner precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day all appanage households in Ganzhou were required to perform relay service according to commoner precedent.

sentences.zh: 申嚴大都總管府、兵馬司、左右巡院斂民之禁。

translations.literal: Strict prohibitions against extorting the people were enforced at the Dadu metropolitan administration, horse-and-troop office, and left and right patrol courts.
translations.idiomatic: Strict prohibitions against extorting the people were enforced at the Dadu metropolitan administration, horse-and-troop office, and left and right patrol courts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以阿剌罕既卒，命阿塔海等分戍三海口，令阿塔海就招海中餘寇。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, because Alahan had died, Atahai and others were ordered to garrison Sanhaikou in divisions, and Atahai was directed to recruit the remaining sea bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, because Alahan had died, Atahai and others were ordered to garrison Sanhaikou in divisions, and Atahai was directed to recruit the remaining sea bandits.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王春遣其密直司使韓康來賀聖誕節。

translations.literal: Goryeo King Wang Chun sent his Military Affairs Bureau envoy Han Kang to congratulate the emperor on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo King Wang Chun sent his Military Affairs Bureau envoy Han Kang to congratulate the emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以開元等路六驛饑，命給幣帛萬二千匹，其鬻妻子者官為贖之。

translations.literal: On renchen day, because six relay stations in Kaiyuan and other routes suffered famine, twelve thousand bolts of silks and cloth were ordered issued; those who had sold wives and children were redeemed by the state.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, because six relay stations in Kaiyuan and other routes suffered famine, 12,000 bolts of silks and cloth were ordered issued; those who had sold wives and children were redeemed by the state.

sentences.zh: 詔征日本軍回，所在官為給糧。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that returning troops from the Japan expedition be provisioned with grain by officials wherever they passed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that returning troops from the Japan expedition be provisioned with grain by officials wherever they passed.

sentences.zh: 忻都、洪茶丘、範文虎、李庭、金方慶諸軍，船為風濤所激，大失利，余軍回至高麗境，十存一二。

translations.literal: The armies of Xindu, Hong Chaqiu, Fan Wenhu, Li Ting, Jin Fangqing, and others, their ships battered by wind and waves, suffered great defeat; the remaining troops returned to Goryeo territory, one or two in ten surviving.
translations.idiomatic: The armies of Xindu, Hong Chaqiu, Fan Wenhu, Li Ting, Jin Fangqing, and others, their ships battered by wind and waves, suffered great defeat; the remaining troops returned to Goryeo territory, only one or two in ten surviving.

sentences.zh: 設醮於上都壽寧宮。

translations.literal: Ritual offerings were performed at Shouning Palace in Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual offerings were performed at Shouning Palace in Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 賜歡只兀部及滅乞裏等羊馬價，及眾家奴等助軍羊馬鈔。

translations.literal: Granted price payments for sheep and horses to the Huanzhiwu tribe and Mieqili and others, and paper currency for sheep and horses to various household slaves who had aided the army.
translations.idiomatic: Price payments for sheep and horses were granted to the Huanzhiwu tribe and Mieqili and others, and paper currency for sheep and horses to various household slaves who had aided the army.

sentences.zh: 賜常河部軍貧乏者，給過西川軍糧。

translations.literal: Granted to impoverished troops of the Changhe division; grain was issued to troops passing through Western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Impoverished troops of the Changhe division were granted relief, and grain was issued to troops passing through Western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 海南諸國來貢象犀方物。

translations.literal: Various Hainan countries sent tribute of elephants, rhinoceros, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: Various Hainan countries sent tribute of elephants, rhinoceros, and local products.

sentences.zh: 給怯薛丹糧，拘其所占田為屯田。

translations.literal: Issued grain rations to keshik; the lands they occupied were seized for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Grain rations were issued to keshik, and the lands they occupied were seized for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳朔，熒惑犯司怪南第二星。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, guisi new moon: Mars transgressed the second star south of the Office of Strangeness.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guisi new moon: Mars transgressed the second star south of the Office of Strangeness.

sentences.zh: 阿塔海乞以戍三海口軍擊福建賊陳吊眼，詔以重勞不從。

translations.literal: Atahai asked to use the Sanhaikou garrison troops to attack Fujian bandit Chen Diaoyan; an edict declined because of excessive fatigue.
translations.idiomatic: Atahai asked to use the Sanhaikou garrison troops to attack Fujian bandit Chen Diaoyan; an edict declined because of excessive fatigue.

sentences.zh: 敕守縉山道侍衛軍還京師。

translations.literal: Ordered the guard troops garrisoning the Jingshan route to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The guard troops garrisoning the Jingshan route were ordered to return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，瓜州屯田進瑞麥一莖五穗。

translations.literal: On renchen day Gua Prefecture garrison farm presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with five ears.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Gua Prefecture garrison farm presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with five ears.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Mao.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命播州每歲親貢方物，改思州宣撫司為宣慰司，兼管內安撫使。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Bozhou was ordered to present local tribute in person each year; the Sizhou pacification commission was changed to a pacification and consolation commission, also administering the internal pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Bozhou was ordered to present local tribute in person each year; the Sizhou pacification commission was changed to a pacification and consolation commission, also administering the internal pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 升高麗簽議府為從三品。

translations.literal: Goryeo's Bureau of Deliberation was promoted to third rank, subordinate grade.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo's Bureau of Deliberation was promoted to third rank, subordinate grade.

sentences.zh: 敕中書省減執政及諸司冗員。

translations.literal: Ordered the Central Secretariat to reduce redundant executive and various office personnel.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat was ordered to reduce redundant executive and various office personnel.

sentences.zh: 遣兀良合帶運沙城等糧六千石入和林。

translations.literal: Sent Uryangqadai to transport six thousand shi of grain from Shacheng and elsewhere into Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: Uryangqadai was sent to transport 6,000 shi of grain from Shacheng and elsewhere into Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 括江南戶口稅課。

translations.literal: Registered Jiangnan household population and tax levies.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan household population and tax levies were registered.

sentences.zh: 庚申，安南國貢方物。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Annam sent tribute of local products.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Annam sent tribute of local products.

sentences.zh: 江西行省薦舉兵官，命罷之。

translations.literal: The Jiangxi Branch Secretariat recommended military officials; an order dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi Branch Secretariat recommended military officials; an order dismissed them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔諭斡端等三城官民及忽都帶兒，括不闌奚人口。

translations.literal: On renxu day an edict instructed officials and people of the three cities of Woduan and others and Qutudaier to register Bulangxi population.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict instructed officials and people of the three cities of Woduan and others and Qutudaier to register Bulangxi population.

sentences.zh: 兩淮轉運使阿剌瓦丁坐盜官鈔二萬一千五百錠，盜取和買馬三百四十四匹，朝廷宣命格而弗頒，又以官員所佩符擅與家奴往來貿易等事，伏誅。

translations.literal: Lianghuai transport commissioner Alawadin was executed for embezzling twenty-one thousand five hundred ingots of official notes, stealing three hundred forty-four government-purchased horses, withholding imperial orders and not promulgating them, and unauthorized trading with household slaves using official tally seals.
translations.idiomatic: Lianghuai transport commissioner Alawadin was executed for embezzling 21,500 ingots of official notes, stealing 344 government-purchased horses, withholding imperial orders and not promulgating them, and unauthorized trading with household slaves using official tally seals.

sentences.zh: 賜謙州屯田軍人鈔幣、衣裘等物，及給農具漁具。

translations.literal: Granted notes, silks, fur clothing, and the like to garrison farmers at Qian Prefecture, and issued farming and fishing implements.
translations.idiomatic: Notes, silks, fur clothing, and the like were granted to garrison farmers at Qian Prefecture, and farming and fishing implements were issued.

sentences.zh: 償站匠等助軍羊馬價。

translations.literal: Reimbursed relay artisans and others for sheep and horses contributed to the army.
translations.idiomatic: Relay artisans and others were reimbursed for sheep and horses contributed to the army.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥朔，畋於近郊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guihai new moon: hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guihai new moon: hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，增大都巡兵千人。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Dadu patrol troops were increased by one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Dadu patrol troops were increased by 1,000.

sentences.zh: 給鈔賑上都饑民。

translations.literal: Issued notes to relieve famine victims at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were issued to relieve famine victims at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，商賈市舶物貨已經泉州抽分者，諸處貿易，止令輸稅。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, for merchant maritime goods already assessed at Quanzhou, trade at other places required only payment of tax.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, for merchant maritime goods already assessed at Quanzhou, trade at other places required only payment of tax.

sentences.zh: 益耽羅戍兵，仍命高麗國給戰具。

translations.literal: Increased Tamna garrison troops and ordered Goryeo to supply military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: Tamna garrison troops were increased and Goryeo was ordered to supply military equipment.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，還宮。

translations.literal: On gengchen day returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大都立蒙古站屯田，編戶歲輸包銀者及真定等路闌遺戶，並令屯田，其在真定者與免皮貨。

translations.literal: On xinsi day garrison farms were established at Mongol relay stations in Dadu; registered households paying annual lump-sum silver and stray households in Zhending and other routes were all ordered to garrison-farm; those in Zhending were exempted from fur goods levies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day garrison farms were established at Mongol relay stations in Dadu; registered households paying annual lump-sum silver and stray households in Zhending and other routes were all ordered to garrison-farm; those in Zhending were exempted from fur goods levies.

sentences.zh: 癸未，京兆等路歲辦課額，自一萬九千錠增至五萬四千錠，阿合馬尚以為未實，欲核之。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the annual tax quota of Jingzhao and other routes was raised from nineteen thousand to fifty-four thousand ingots; Ahmad still thought it insufficient and wanted to audit it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the annual tax quota of Jingzhao and other routes was raised from 19,000 to 54,000 ingots; Ahmad still thought it insufficient and wanted to audit it.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「阿合馬何知。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "What does Ahmad know.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "What does Ahmad know?

sentences.zh: 」事遂止。

translations.literal: " The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was then dropped.

sentences.zh: 大都、新安縣民復和顧和買。

translations.literal: People of Dadu and Xin'an County again bore corvée purchase requisitions.
translations.idiomatic: People of Dadu and Xin'an County again bore corvée purchase requisitions.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the moon transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，占城國來貢方物。

translations.literal: On renchen day Champa sent tribute of local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Champa sent tribute of local products.

sentences.zh: 賜修大都城侍衛軍鈔幣帛有差，賞北征軍銀鈔。

translations.literal: Granted notes, silks, and cloth in graded amounts to guard troops repairing Dadu walls; rewarded northern expedition troops with silver notes.
translations.idiomatic: Notes, silks, and cloth in graded amounts were granted to guard troops repairing Dadu walls, and northern expedition troops were rewarded with silver notes.

sentences.zh: 賜怯憐口及四斡耳朵下與範文虎所部將士羊馬、衣服、幣帛有差。

translations.literal: Granted sheep, horses, clothing, and silks in graded amounts to qielian retainers, those under the four ordos, and officers and soldiers under Fan Wenhu.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep, horses, clothing, and silks in graded amounts were granted to qielian retainers, those under the four ordos, and officers and soldiers under Fan Wenhu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，享於太廟，貞懿順聖昭天睿文光應皇后祔。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yiwei day: offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; Empress Zhenyishun Shengzhao Tianrui Wenguang Ying was enshrined.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, yiwei day: offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; Empress Zhenyishun Shengzhao Tianrui Wenguang Ying was enshrined.

sentences.zh: 丙申，募民淮西屯田。

translations.literal: On bingshen day commoners were recruited for garrison farming in Huai-west.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day commoners were recruited for garrison farming in Huai-west.

sentences.zh: 己亥，議封安南王號，易所賜安南國畏吾字虎符，以國字書之；

translations.literal: On jihai day deliberation was held on enfeoffing the king of Annam; the Uighur-script tiger tally granted to Annam was replaced with one inscribed in the national script;
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day deliberation was held on enfeoffing the king of Annam; the Uighur-script tiger tally granted to Annam was replaced with one inscribed in the national script;

sentences.zh: 仍降詔諭安南國，立日烜之叔遺愛為安南國王。

translations.literal: An edict was also issued instructing Annam to install Ri Xuan's uncle Yiai as king of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was also issued instructing Annam to install Ri Xuan's uncle Yiai as king of Annam.

sentences.zh: 庚子，溪洞新附官鎮安州岑從毅，縱兵殺掠，迫死知州李顯祖，召從毅入覲。

translations.literal: On gengzi day newly submitted xidong official and Zhen'an Prefecture prefect Cen Congyi let his troops kill and plunder, forcing prefect Li Xianzu to death; Congyi was summoned to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day newly submitted xidong official and Zhen'an Prefecture prefect Cen Congyi let his troops kill and plunder, forcing prefect Li Xianzu to death; Congyi was summoned to audience.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜征日本將校衣裝、幣帛、靴帽等物有差。

translations.literal: On renyin day Japan expedition officers and commanders were granted clothing, silks, boots, and hats in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Japan expedition officers and commanders were granted clothing, silks, boots, and hats in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命安西王府協濟戶及南山隘口軍，於安西、延安、鳳翔、六盤等處屯田。

translations.literal: On yisi day Anxi Prince's xieji households and Nanshan pass troops were ordered to garrison-farm at Anxi, Yan'an, Fengxiang, Liupan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Anxi Prince's xieji households and Nanshan pass troops were ordered to garrison-farm at Anxi, Yan'an, Fengxiang, Liupan, and other places.

sentences.zh: 河西置織毛段匠提舉司。

translations.literal: A bureau for supervising wool-weaving artisans was established in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: A bureau for supervising wool-weaving artisans was established in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，安南國置宣慰司，以北京路達魯花赤孛顏帖木兒參知政事，行安南國宣慰使，都元帥、佩虎符柴椿、忽哥兒副之。

translations.literal: On dingwei day a pacification and consolation commission was established in Annam; Dadu Route darughachi Baidu Temür was made associate administrator and acting Annam pacification commissioner, with grand commander and tiger-tally bearer Chai Chun and Hu Koer as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day a pacification and consolation commission was established in Annam; Dadu Route darughachi Baidu Temür was made associate administrator and acting Annam pacification commissioner, with grand commander and tiger-tally bearer Chai Chun and Hu Koer as deputies.

sentences.zh: 給鈔萬錠，付河西行省以備經費。

translations.literal: Granted ten thousand ingots of notes to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for operating expenses.
translations.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots of notes were granted to the Hexi Branch Secretariat for operating expenses.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張易等言：「參校道書，惟《道德經》系老子親著，餘皆後人偽撰，宜悉焚毀。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Zhang Yi and others said: "Examining Daoist texts, only the Daodejing was personally authored by Laozi; the rest were all later forgeries and should be entirely burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Zhang Yi and others said, "Examining Daoist texts, only the Daodejing was personally authored by Laozi; the rest were all later forgeries and should be entirely burned.

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍詔諭天下。

translations.literal: " Approved; an edict also instructed the empire.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved, and an edict also instructed the empire.

sentences.zh: 給隆興行省海青符。

translations.literal: Issued sea-eagle tally seals to the Longxing Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Sea-eagle tally seals were issued to the Longxing Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 命失裏咱牙信合八剌麻合叠瓦為占城郡王，加榮祿大夫，賜虎符。

translations.literal: Shilizhaya Xinhebala Mahediewa was made Prince of Champa, promoted to grand master of glorious blessing, and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Shilizhaya Xinhebala Mahediewa was made Prince of Champa, promoted to grand master of glorious blessing, and granted a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 立行中書省占城。

translations.literal: A Champa branch secretariat was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Champa branch secretariat was established.

sentences.zh: 以唆都為右丞，劉深為左丞，兵部侍郎也裏迷失參知政事。

translations.literal: Suodu was made right vice minister, Liu Shen left vice minister, and Ministry of War vice minister Yelimissi associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Suodu was made right vice minister, Liu Shen left vice minister, and Ministry of War vice minister Yelimissi associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，敕以海船百艘，新舊軍及水手合萬人，期以明年正月征海外諸番，仍諭占城郡王給軍食。

translations.literal: On gengxu day an edict ordered one hundred sea ships, old and new troops and sailors totaling ten thousand men, to campaign against various overseas fan in the first month of next year; the Prince of Champa was also instructed to supply army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict ordered 100 sea ships, old and new troops and sailors totaling 10,000 men, to campaign against various overseas fan in the first month of next year; the Prince of Champa was also instructed to supply army provisions.

sentences.zh: 以安南國王陳遺愛入安南，發新附軍千人衛送。

translations.literal: When Annam king Chen Yiai entered Annam, one thousand newly submitted troops were dispatched to escort him.
translations.idiomatic: When Annam king Chen Yiai entered Annam, 1,000 newly submitted troops were dispatched to escort him.

sentences.zh: 詔諭幹不昔國來歸附。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Ganbuxi country to come and submit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed Ganbuxi country to come and submit.

sentences.zh: 壬子，用和禮霍孫言，於揚州、隆興、鄂州、泉州四省，置蒙古提舉學校官各二員。

translations.literal: On renzi day, following Helihuosun's proposal, two Mongol school commissioner posts were established in each of the four provinces of Yangzhou, Longxing, Ezhou, and Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, following Helihuosun's proposal, two Mongol school commissioner posts were established in each of the four provinces of Yangzhou, Longxing, Ezhou, and Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨撒裏蠻兼領會同館、集賢院事，以平章政事、樞密副使張易兼領秘書監、太史院、司天臺事，以翰林學士承旨和禮霍孫守司徒。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician-expositor Saliman was also put in charge of the Reception Hall and Academy of Scholarly Worthies; grand councillor and privy council vice director Zhang Yi was also put in charge of the Imperial Library, Astronomical Bureau, and Directorate of Astronomy; Hanlin academician-expositor Helihuosun was ordered to retain the post of minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician-expositor Saliman was also put in charge of the Reception Hall and Academy of Scholarly Worthies; grand councillor and privy council vice director Zhang Yi was also put in charge of the Imperial Library, Astronomical Bureau, and Directorate of Astronomy; Hanlin academician-expositor Helihuosun was ordered to retain the post of minister of education.

sentences.zh: 改大都南陽真定等處屯田孛蘭奚總管府為農政院。

translations.literal: The Bolangxi garrison-farm headquarters for Dadu, Nanyang, Zhending, and other places was changed to an Agriculture Administration.
translations.idiomatic: The Bolangxi garrison-farm headquarters for Dadu, Nanyang, Zhending, and other places was changed to an Agriculture Administration.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，皇太子至自北邊。

translations.literal: On guichou day the crown prince arrived from the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the crown prince arrived from the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以兀良合帶言，上都南四站人畜困乏，賜鈔給之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, following Uryangqadai's report that people and livestock at the four relay stations south of Shangdu were exhausted, notes were granted to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, following Uryangqadai's report that people and livestock at the four relay stations south of Shangdu were exhausted, notes were granted to supply them.

sentences.zh: 庚申，籍西川戶。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Western Sichuan households were registered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Western Sichuan households were registered.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，邵武叛人高日新降。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Shaowu rebel Gao Rixin submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Shaowu rebel Gao Rixin submitted.

sentences.zh: 給征日本回侍衛新附軍冬衣。

translations.literal: Issued winter clothing to guard newly submitted troops returning from the Japan expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Winter clothing was issued to guard newly submitted troops returning from the Japan expedition.

sentences.zh: 賜劉天錫等銀幣，勝兀剌等羊馬鈔，諸王阿只吉等馬牛羊，各有差。

translations.literal: Granted silver and silks to Liu Tiansi and others, paper currency for sheep and horses to Shengwula and others, and horses, cattle, and sheep to princes including Ajji in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Silver and silks were granted to Liu Tiansi and others, paper currency for sheep and horses to Shengwula and others, and horses, cattle, and sheep to princes including Ajji in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥朔，詔諭探馬禮，令歸附。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guihai new moon: an edict instructed Tanmali to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guihai new moon: an edict instructed Tanmali to submit.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敕誅陳吊眼首惡者，余並收其兵仗，系送京師。

translations.literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered execution of Chen Diaoyan's ringleaders; the rest had their weapons confiscated and were sent to the capital in custody.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered execution of Chen Diaoyan's ringleaders; the rest had their weapons confiscated and were sent to the capital in custody.

sentences.zh: 己巳，敕軍器監給兵仗付高麗沿海等郡。

translations.literal: On jisi day the Directorate of Armaments was ordered to supply weapons to Goryeo coastal commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Directorate of Armaments was ordered to supply weapons to Goryeo coastal commanderies.

sentences.zh: 奉使占城孟慶元、孫勝夫並為廣州宣慰使，兼領出征調度。

translations.literal: Champa envoys Meng Qingyuan and Sun Shengfu were both made Guangzhou pacification commissioners, also overseeing expedition logistics.
translations.idiomatic: Champa envoys Meng Qingyuan and Sun Shengfu were both made Guangzhou pacification commissioners, also overseeing expedition logistics.

sentences.zh: 高麗國、金州等處置鎮邊萬戶府，以控制日本。

translations.literal: In Goryeo, Jin Prefecture, and other places frontier defense wanhu headquarters were established to control Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In Goryeo, Jin Prefecture, and other places frontier defense wanhu headquarters were established to control Japan.

sentences.zh: 高日新及其弟鼎新等至闕，以日新兩為叛首，授山北路民職。

translations.literal: Gao Rixin and his brother Dingxin and others came to court; because Rixin had twice been a rebel leader, he was given a civilian post in the Shanbei Route.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Rixin and his brother Dingxin and others came to court; because Rixin had twice been a rebel leader, he was given a civilian post in the Shanbei Route.

sentences.zh: 文慶之屬，遣還泉州。

translations.literal: Wen Qing's followers were sent back to Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Qing's followers were sent back to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賜有功將校二百二十三員銀十萬兩及幣帛、弓矢、鞍勒有差。

translations.literal: Granted two hundred twenty-three meritorious officers and commanders one hundred thousand taels of silver and silks, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: 223 meritorious officers and commanders were granted 100,000 taels of silver and silks, bows and arrows, and saddles and bridles in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 詔安南國王給占城行省軍食。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the king of Annam to supply provisions to the Champa branch secretariat army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the king of Annam to supply provisions to the Champa branch secretariat army.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王請完濱海城，防日本，不允。

translations.literal: The Goryeo king requested to complete coastal fortifications against Japan; not approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Goryeo king requested to complete coastal fortifications against Japan; the request was not approved.

sentences.zh: 辛未，給諸王阿只吉糧六千石。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Prince Ajji was granted six thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Prince Ajji was granted 6,000 shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太陰犯五車次南星。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed the star south of the second Wuche.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed the star south of the second Wuche.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，召法師劉道真，問祠太乙法。

translations.literal: On yihai day Daoist master Liu Daozhen was summoned to inquire about rites for offering to Taiyi.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Daoist master Liu Daozhen was summoned to inquire about rites for offering to Taiyi.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太陰犯鬼。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Gui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon transgressed Gui.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔諭瓜哇國主，使親來覲。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict instructed the king of Java to come to court in person.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict instructed the king of Java to come to court in person.

sentences.zh: 昌州及蓋裏泊民饑，給鈔賑之。

translations.literal: People of Chang Prefecture and Gaili Lake suffered famine; notes were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: People of Chang Prefecture and Gaili Lake suffered famine; notes were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，給鈔二萬錠付和林貿易。

translations.literal: On bingxu day twenty thousand ingots of notes were granted for trade at Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day 20,000 ingots of notes were granted for trade at Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 敕征日本回軍後至者分戍沿海。

translations.literal: Ordered late-returning troops from the Japan expedition to garrison the coast in divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Late-returning troops from the Japan expedition were ordered to garrison the coast in divisions.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太陰掩心東星。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the moon occulted the eastern star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon occulted the eastern star of the Heart.

sentences.zh: 給揚州行省新附軍將校鈔，人二錠。

translations.literal: Granted notes to newly submitted army officers and commanders of the Yangzhou Branch Secretariat, two ingots per man.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were granted to newly submitted army officers and commanders of the Yangzhou Branch Secretariat, two ingots per man.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜安南國出征新附軍鈔。

translations.literal: On jiyou day paper money was granted to the newly submitted troops of Annam who had gone on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day paper money was granted to Annam's newly submitted troops who had gone on campaign.

sentences.zh: 賜禮部尚書留夢炎及出使馬八國俺都剌等鈔各有差。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Liu Mengyan and Andula, envoy to Ma-ba country, and others were granted paper money in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Liu Mengyan, Andula, envoy to Ma-ba country, and others received paper money in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，以甕吉剌帶為中書右丞相。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiawu day, Wengjiladai was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jiawu day, Wengjiladai was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷日本行中書省。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Japan Branch Secretariat was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Japan branch secretariat was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，議選侍衛軍萬人練習，以備扈從。

translations.literal: On dingwei day it was deliberated to select ten thousand Imperial Guard troops for drill, to stand ready for escort duty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day it was deliberated to select ten thousand Imperial Guard troops for drill to stand ready for escort duty.

sentences.zh: 升太常寺為正三品。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to regular rank three.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to regular rank three.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命西川行省給萬家奴所部兵仗。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the West Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply arms and armor to Wanjianu's command.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the West Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to supply arms and armor to Wanjianu's command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，敕免益都、淄萊、寧海開河夫今年租賦，仍給其傭直。

translations.literal: On guichou day an edict exempted canal laborers of Yidu, Zilai, and Ninghai from this year's rent and levies, and still paid them hire wages.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict exempted canal laborers of Yidu, Zilai, and Ninghai from this year's rent and levies and still paid them hire wages.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以諸王劄忽兒所占文安縣地給付屯田。

translations.literal: On yimao day land in Wen'an County occupied by Prince Jaqur was handed over for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day land in Wen'an County occupied by Prince Jaqur was handed over for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，調新附軍屯田。

translations.literal: On bingchen day newly submitted troops were transferred to garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day newly submitted troops were transferred to garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 獲福州叛賊林天成，戮於市。

translations.literal: The Fuzhou rebel Lin Tiancheng was captured and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The Fuzhou rebel Lin Tiancheng was captured and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 免福州路今年稅二分，十八年以前租稅並免征。

translations.literal: Fuzhou Route was exempted from two-tenths of this year's tax, and rents and levies before the eighteenth year were wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou Route was exempted from two-tenths of this year's tax, and all rents and levies before the eighteenth year were remitted.

sentences.zh: 以漢州德陽縣隸成都府。

translations.literal: Deyang County of Han Prefecture was placed under Chengdu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Deyang County of Han Prefecture was placed under Chengdu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改漳州為路。

translations.literal: Zhang Prefecture was changed to a route.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Prefecture was made a route.

sentences.zh: 賜禮部尚書謝昌元鈔。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Xie Changyuan was granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Xie Changyuan received paper money.

sentences.zh: 賞捏古伯戰功銀有差。

translations.literal: Niegube was rewarded for battle merit with silver in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Niegube was rewarded for battle merit with silver in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 償阿只吉等助軍馬價。

translations.literal: Horse prices were paid to Ajiji and others for auxiliary army horses.
translations.idiomatic: Horse prices were paid to Ajiji and others for auxiliary army horses.

sentences.zh: 賜塔剌海籍沒戶五十。

translations.literal: Talaqai was granted fifty confiscated households.
translations.idiomatic: Talaqai received fifty confiscated households.

sentences.zh: 是歲，保定路清苑縣水，平陽路松山縣旱，高唐、夏津、武城等縣蟊害稼，並免今年租，計三萬六千八百四十石。

translations.literal: That year Qingyuan County of Baoding Route suffered flood, Songshan County of Pingyang Route drought, and Gaotang, Xiajin, Wucheng, and other counties locust damage to crops; this year's rent was remitted in all, totaling thirty-six thousand eight hundred forty shi.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qingyuan County of Baoding Route flooded, Songshan County of Pingyang Route suffered drought, and locusts damaged crops in Gaotang, Xiajin, Wucheng, and other counties; this year's rent was remitted in all, totaling thirty-six thousand eight hundred forty shi.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪二十二人。

translations.literal: Twenty-two persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-two persons were sentenced to death.
